mapper.select: SELECT t.level AS difficulty, t.category, t.total_score AS totalReward, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, u.username AS trainerName, u.user_profile_url AS trainerProfileImage, t.average_rating AS trainingRating, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.training_id = t.training_id) AS enrolledTraineeCount, t.title, t.description FROM trainings t JOIN trainer_profiles tp ON t.trainer_id = tp.trainer_id JOIN users u ON tp.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId}
SELECT r.routine_type AS category, r.title AS routineTitle FROM routines r WHERE r.training_id = #{trainingId} ORDER BY r.routine_type, r.order_number
